problems: EXTRA FILE: data_monthly.csv.gz (same columns as data.csv, 1,523,215 rows) holds the monthly station/district/province counts published inside the quarterly workbooks and the 2019/20 annual workbook; data.csv holds financial-year and quarter values (529,807 rows). Measures: SAPS publishes Murder, Attempted murder and Culpable homicide (culpable homicide = unlawful negligent killing, NOT intentional; kept as its own measure). Annual workbooks from 2023/24 on carry only Murder and Attempted murder in the station table. Police station level: SAPS station boundaries/points are only available through a request form (name + email) at https://www.saps.gov.za/services/boundary.php, under a disclaimer that the data 'shall not be made available to any other person or entity without the express permission of the South African Police Service' (Spatial Data Infrastructure Act 54 of 2003). Not open, so not downloaded; station rows have no shape and no lat/lon. SAPS police districts (2022/23 onwards) are aggregates of station areas named after the municipal districts/metros; they were matched by name to geoBoundaries ADM2 district municipalities (old names in geoBoundaries: Cacadu=Sarah Baartman, Eden=Garden Route, Sisonke=Harry Gwala, Uthungulu=King Cetshwayo; SAPS abbreviations Dr KK, Dr RSM, NMM matched to the full names). SAPS district boundaries follow station areas so they may differ slightly at the edges from the municipal districts. Province rows are SAPS's own provincial totals (they equal the sum of stations). National rows dropped (not subnational). Station names: older workbooks use upper case; they were mapped to the title-case spelling of newer workbooks where the upper-cased names are identical, otherwise left as published. Some station names occur in two provinces (e.g. Laersdrift in Mpumalanga and Limpopo); use parent_name to tell them apart. Period labels: financial year 'YYYY/YYYY' = April-March; quarters as 'Mon-Mon YYYY'; months (data_monthly.csv.gz) as YYYY-MM. Missing: 2024/25 Q2 and Q4 Excel files linked on the SAPS page return 404 (PDFs only); no 2022/23 annual Excel workbook is linked (PDF only, not extracted); 2023/24 annual 'Financial year' xlsx link returns 404. Older pre-2019/20 releases are not on the SAPS site as Excel. SAPS site serves an incomplete TLS certificate chain; the missing Sectigo intermediate was added from crt.sh to download.
